title: Options Strategies & Breakevens

sections.heading: Core Concepts (Memorize)
items: 1 contract = 100 shares; premium quoted per share (×100 = $ cost)
Buyer = Long = Holder = pays premium = HAS THE RIGHT
Seller = Short = Writer = receives premium = HAS THE OBLIGATION
Calls: Buyer BULLISH, Writer BEARISH
Puts: Buyer BEARISH, Writer BULLISH
Premium = Intrinsic Value (IV) + Time Value (TV)
IV is NEVER negative (min = 0); At/Out of money = IV of 0
Parity = premium equals intrinsic value exactly

sections.heading: ITM / ATM / OTM (Buyers want ITM; Sellers want OTM)
The 4 Basic Positions — BE / MG / ML
Memory Aids — Breakeven
items: CALL UP: Strike + Premium  (Call buyer needs stock to go UP past BE)
PUT DOWN: Strike − Premium (Put buyer needs stock to go DOWN past BE)
BE is SAME for buyer & seller; one's MG = other's ML

sections.heading: Intrinsic vs. Time Value
items: IV (Call) = Stock − Strike (if positive, else 0)
IV (Put) = Strike − Stock (if positive, else 0)
TV = Premium − IV
TV increases with: more time to expiration + higher volatility
At expiration: TV = 0; premium = IV only

items.Used for: Equity options, most equity index options
Foreign currency options, yield-based (interest rate) options

sections.heading: Quick BE Examples
items: Long 1 XYZ Jul 40 call @ 3 → BE = 43; MG = unlimited; ML = $300
Long 1 XYZ Jul 40 put @ 3 → BE = 37; MG = $3,700; ML = $300
Long 40 call + Long 40 put @ 2 each (straddle) → BEs = 36 & 44; ML = $400
Long stock @ 50 + Long 50 put @ 2 (protective put) → BE = 52; ML = $200

common_traps: BE for protective put is Stock price + Premium (NOT strike − premium). The formula changes once stock is combined with the option.
Short naked CALL = UNLIMITED loss; Short naked PUT loss is LIMITED (Strike − Premium) — students often reverse these.
Straddle has TWO breakevens (Strike + total premium AND Strike − total premium); use TOTAL combined premium, not just one leg.
At-the-money and Out-of-the-money options have ZERO intrinsic value — all premium is time value. IV is never negative.
Yield-based and foreign currency options are EUROPEAN style (expiration day only) — easy trap when question implies early exercise.
Call BE = Strike + Premium for BOTH buyer and seller (same number); the buyer profits ABOVE BE, seller profits BELOW BE.
